quote: When I was younger I wanted to be a big movie star who'd get to be funny on talk shows and then I wanted to retire and write science fiction.
author: Scott Thompson

quote: When you are not treated seriously, you develop comically. Its sense of oneself is so fractured and fragile that it's like the picked-on kid who has to become funny.

quote: I got pregnant at 40 by surprise. It's funny, because when we found out we were pregnant, I said, 'Okay, let's experience that.' You just have to just go with it because it's rare.
author: Julianna Margulies

author: Rufus Sewell

author: Jerry B. Jenkins

author: John Keegan

quote: Most of my ideas just come out funny.
author: Tim Heidecker

quote: Sometimes laughing isn't the best judge of what's funny, 'cause I think there's a lot of things that are really funny that don't make you laugh, that don't make you physically, audibly make a noise, but is something that is much more powerful than that.

quote: There is nothing funny about a well-adjusted, intelligent person making the right choices.
author: Tim Heidecker

quote: I'm always in situations where you can't be funny, and yet I want to do it anyway.
author: Tim Heidecker

quote: It's a funny thing about me. I don't have any interest in food most of the time now, although when I was a kid I was always hungry.
author: Alan Ladd

quote: I wasn't even 20 at the time, but it taught me something about drugs. They can take a good man, a warm, funny, loving family man, and turn him into a loser and worse.
author: Michael Bergin

quote: I believe, in a funny way, the job of the novelist is to be out there on the fringes and speaking for an experience that has not really been spoken for.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: Funny, how moms can tell you what to do no matter how old or big you are.
author: Gabrielle Reece

quote: I didn't grow up identifying with beauty. I grew up thinking I could be smart and funny - those are the things I got feedback on.
author: Lauren Graham

quote: Inappropriateness is funny to me. Rudeness is hilarious.
author: Zach Galifianakis

quote: I think if they put a laugh track on 'Intervention,' it would be funny.
author: Zach Galifianakis

quote: We all know how funny Morrissey is. Actually, you know what? I say that sarcastically. His songs are some of the funniest songs I've ever heard in my life. I mean, really. I mean, not that the 'Girlfriend in a Coma' is, like, really funny.
author: Zach Galifianakis

quote: When I was in high school I used to sit by myself in the cafeteria - not necessarily by choice - but I thought it was funny to talk to people that weren't there.

quote: Laughter is involuntary. If it's funny you laugh.
author: Tom Lehrer

quote: What's funny about that is when I was writing Twilight just for myself and not thinking of it as a book, I was not thinking about publishing, and yet at the same time I was casting it in my head. Because when I read books, I see them very visually.

quote: It's so different when you change your hair color, you're treated so differently. It's a very funny experience. It's fun - I love changing up my hair.

quote: When I turned about 12 or 13, I realised that being funny wasn't about remembering jokes. It was about creating them.

quote: They're great girls. They're very funny, they're very smart, they're fun to be with. They're very lively, as I think people can tell. And you know, they're very confident girls.
author: Laura Bush

quote: It's funny, but we were living on this small island off the coast of Charleston, South Carolina when I was 9.
author: Josh Lucas

quote: I have no agenda except to be funny. Neither I or the writers profess to offer any worldly wisdom.
author: Julia Louis-Dreyfus

quote: In my experience, it's not just that serious books get a hearing on comedy shows. But serious books get a serious hearing, as well as a funny one, on comedy shows.
author: Michael Mandelbaum

quote: It's a bit like school camp, shooting a film. Everyone's on heat. It's a strange energy. It's full of adrenalin. I funnel my excess energy in funny little ways. I do a lot of dancing in my trailer. I love music.
author: Alice Englert

quote: Here's the funny thing about the response I've been aware of to my dating famous people: It's been very negative. I'm either not good-looking enough, not a good enough actor or not successful enough for these people.
author: Dax Shepard

quote: I like the hot-cold, the sugar-salt, being able to play over-the-top and dramatic things - in the same film. Just as in my life, I can be very funny and at other times almost extinguished.
author: Jean Dujardin

quote: I'm an off-road racecar driver. And I think every woman in my life has told me that's not a sensible hobby. author: Dax Shepard

quote: Kyle Baker's work is really funny, but it's also got a very clear vision.
author: Bill Sienkiewicz

quote: It's funny: I've been very successful and done a lot of films, and I don't really have an agent - I don't really pursue jobs, I let people come to me.
author: Rick Baker

quote: If you look at the game and everything, it's not quite like looking at an animated film, because that's total character. This, this is really movement, but it's got funny little things if you look for the humor. They're actually getting to the character.

quote: It's a funny thing because you look at the careers of other filmmakers, and you see them sort of slow down, and you realize, maybe this becomes harder to do as you get older. That's sort of a cautionary thing. I hope it doesn't happen to me.
author: Joel Coen

quote: There's a darkness under 'The Hangover' because ultimately there's a missing person and it's not really that funny. There's a sort of darkness under it that I love, and still people are laughing as hard if not harder than they did in 'Old School.'

quote: I think people like comedies and I think concept driven comedies seem to be working when it's a clear concept and you deliver funny stuff.

quote: I would do it today because the thing that appealed to me was not necessarily the mechanics of the robot, but it was his personality and how funny and charming he was.

quote: If you can find the line between sympathetic and creepy, you have reached a very funny area.
author: Jason Segel

quote: I don't think the public is dying to see me necessarily be funny all the time.
author: Ben Stiller

quote: I love New York. I was sad, depressed and incredibly moved by our fellow countrymen and what they've done. I wanted to give people a chance to see something funny, have a distraction.
author: Ben Stiller

quote: Jim Carrey, a comic genius, has a harder time overcoming the public's desire for him to be funny simply because he's so good at it.

author: Daryl Hall

quote: Because death and illness are the most horrible things in life, of course that's where the most absurdly funny things are going to happen.
author: Julia Sweeney

quote: I think one of the basic tasks in life - one of the nice things we can do for each other - is to take things that are horrible and scary and make them acceptable and less frightening and, if possible, funny. It feels great to succeed at that.
author: Julia Sweeney

quote: I appreciate humor so much, but I'm actually not a funny girl.

quote: I don't think my judgment is that good. I don't know what is funny.
author: Jerry Stiller

quote: It's funny, the hardest thing to do is to make something look like it's fast, loose and improvised, and get somebody to laugh.
author: Abel Ferrara

quote: Sometimes we have to actually say, I think you're really funny, but none of your jokes are going to make it on the air. So just answer my questions. Seriously.
author: Rob Corddry

quote: I'm not a comedian. I'm an actor who just happens to be funny on occasion.
author: Anthony Anderson

quote: 'Lucky' is for laughs, and there's really nothing funny that I'm doing on 'Dexter.' I think more than anything, both comment on the fact that anybody is capable of anything. Just because they are the shy guy in the corner doesn't mean that they are a harmless little bunny.
author: Colin Hanks

quote: There have been times when I felt suicidal and I would stop my head from going in that direction of negativity because I thought there'd be something I'd miss that was funny in the future. If there's a chance I'm going to laugh tomorrow then want to live to experience that.

quote: And remember, it's also very funny, because side by side with grief lies joy.
author: Fran Drescher

quote: I liked getting the best villain award. I thought that was funny.
author: Stephen Dorff

quote: The music industry is really funny, when you have a hit record, everyone knows who are you, everyone wants to do duets with you, then if you have a miss, people suffer from amnesia.
author: Seal

quote: This is funny because I just had a job over the summer for VH1, a project I did called Strange Frequency where I got to play a Goth rock band singer.

quote: I mean, I'm married first of all to one of, if not the most wonderful women in the world. She is everything - funny, attractive, hard-working, she has integrity, she loves me to bits.
author: Seal

quote: A film that I love is 'Raising Arizona' and that's funny but it's quite indie and weird and odd and quirky. I'd love to do something like that. Who knows?

quote: And of course Marc Cherry heightens it and makes it hilarious. But there's so many universal themes in the show, and he made it so funny. We knew he was onto something if he could keep it up and, thankfully, he did.

quote: It's so funny when you're actually directing because things start popping that you don't expect to pop, and something that you think is going to pop, maybe doesn't quite have the impetus that you thought it might.

quote: Well, I'm not afraid to say something if I think it's funny, even if it's harsh or racist.

quote: The promos with all of the beautiful women probably attracted some men, but the mystery story line is pretty cool. It's got that dark edge, and people will watch anything funny.

quote: But I think you can make fun of anything as long as it's funny enough.
author: Sarah Silverman

quote: It's funny, because '1600 Penn' was the first time I really started to read the reviews, because I am an executive producer and I wanted to see what people were enjoying and not enjoying as a means to an end, right?

quote: I mean, I talk about being Jewish a lot. It's funny because I do think of myself as Jewish ethnically, but I'm not religious at all. I have no religion.
author: Sarah Silverman

quote: It's funny because 'The Book of Mormon' is 'The Book of Mormon' now. When I was doing it at the very beginning, and I was a part of it for four years and always believed in it, I never really knew if it was going to be more than a convention for 'South Park' fans.
author: Josh Gad

quote: I know people will think it's funny because I've done glamour modelling in the past, but I felt embarrassed about my body and just wanted to cover it up.

quote: My parents, grandparents, aunts and uncles were all funny, and I felt that energy, that delivery, that timing, that sarcasm. All that stuff seeped into my brain.

quote: Wikipedia is just an incredible thing. It is fact-encirclingly huge, and it is idiosyncratic, careful, messy, funny, shocking and full of simmering controversies - and it is free, and it is fast.
author: Nicholson Baker

quote: I don't write literary fiction - I write books that are entertaining, but are also, I hope, well-constructed and thoughtful and funny and have things to say about men and women and families and children and life in America today.
author: Jennifer Weiner

quote: Do you want me to apologize after every joke? If it doesn't offend somebody it's probably not a joke. It's probably an observation that's not funny. It's gotta offend somebody somewhere.

quote: I've actually tried to roast somebody that I don't like, and it doesn't go well. Either they're a bad sport or I'm not as funny as I could be.
author: Jeff Ross

quote: My parents are both very funny but they're also relatively soft-spoken, normal human beings while I'm just a lunatic. I don't know where this loud, ballsy, hammy ridiculousness came from. author: Emma Stone

author: Ashley Judd

quote: People are funny, and in the most tragic situations, when comedy erupts from nowhere, it can turn on its head within the space of a second or a minute. You're laughing one minute and you're crying the next and that's just life for me, and that is what people are like.

quote: So it was just funny to read a script that was just similar to what had been going on in my life.

quote: I have a funny family, but none of them are remotely in show business.

quote: It is funny because the guy who is my boss now, Howard Stern, has a similarity there. He got big being a regular guy. He wasn't the greatest looking guy in the world.

quote: But I think funny and talent will always win out I mean, of course there are hurdles, but I think if you're funny you will get over all of that.

quote: The last person they expected to connect with a screenplay was the comedic, blonde actress with the funny voice.

quote: Comedy was the key to everything. I grew up fast and controlled my future by bringing it on faster than it naturally unfolded. I cheated myself out of a childhood but then got a running headstart into adulthood that no one else could keep up with.

quote: Sometimes I make very selfish choices like I did 'Once Upon A Time' for my inner 8-year-old and my hypothetical future child. author: Ginnifer Goodwin

quote: I don't want to be the one to break it to you, but the future ain't that funny.

quote: There have been times when I felt suicidal and I would stop my head from going in that direction of negativity because I thought there'd be something I'd miss that was funny in the future. If there's a chance I'm going to laugh tomorrow then want to live to experience that.
author: Dave Navarro

quote: The space and light up there in Norfolk is wonderfully peaceful. I find myself doing funny things like gardening, and cooking, which I rarely do in London.
author: Jeremy Northam

quote: Laughter is the sensation of feeling good all over and showing it principally in one place.
author: Josh Billings

quote: A sense of humor... is needed armor. Joy in one's heart and some laughter on one's lips is a sign that the person down deep has a pretty good grasp of life.
author: Hugh Sidey

quote: In truth, politeness is artificial good humor, it covers the natural want of it, and ends by rendering habitual a substitute nearly equivalent to the real virtue.
author: Thomas Jefferson

quote: Good humor is a tonic for mind and body. It is the best antidote for anxiety and depression. It is a business asset. It attracts and keeps friends. It lightens human burdens. It is the direct route to serenity and contentment.
author: Grenville Kleiser

quote: I met Woz when I was 13, at a friend's garage. He was about 18. He was, like, the first person I met who knew more electronics than I did at that point. We became good friends, because we shared an interest in computer and we had a sense of humor. We pulled all kinds of pranks together.
author: Steve Jobs

quote: Joyfulness keeps the heart and face young. A good laugh makes us better friends with ourselves and everybody around us.
author: Orison Swett Marden

quote: One can know a man from his laugh, and if you like a man's laugh before you know anything of him, you may confidently say that he is a good man.
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

quote: A good laugh is sunshine in the house.
author: William Makepeace Thackeray

quote: The problem with having a sense of humor is often that people you use it on aren't in a very good mood.

quote: I like a man who can be a real friend, has a good sense of humor, a good pair of shoes and a healthy gold card.
author: Victoria Beckham

quote: It is the test of a good religion whether you can joke about it.

quote: I believe that love and laughter can only happen when one person takes the time to think about what would cause the other person to feel good.
author: Yakov Smirnoff

author: Ben Stein

quote: The Chinese government wants me to say that for many centuries Tibet has been part of China. Even if I make that statement, many people would just laugh. And my statement will not change past history. History is history.
author: Dalai Lama

quote: If it were not for the government, we should have nothing to laugh at in France.
author: Nicolas Chamfort

quote: You must realize that honorary degrees are given generally to people whose SAT scores were too low to get them into schools the regular way. As a matter of fact, it was my SAT scores that led me into my present vocation in life, comedy.
author: Neil Simon

quote: My great hope is to laugh as much as I cry to get my work done and try to love somebody and have the courage to accept the love in return.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: My life has been one great big joke, a dance that's walked a song that's spoke, I laugh so hard I almost choke when I think about myself.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: Forgive, O Lord, my little jokes on Thee, and I'll forgive Thy great big joke on me.
author: Robert Frost

quote: The overwhelming majority of Americans are possessed of two great qualities a sense of humor and a sense of proportion.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

quote: I wear black skinny-fit jeans - I can't get away from them. It's funny because I wore baggy jeans for ages, then one day my friend convinced me to try on a skinny pair and I thought they were great.
author: Shaun White

quote: Don't wish me happiness - I don't expect to be happy it's gotten beyond that, somehow. Wish me courage and strength and a sense of humor - I will need them all.
author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

quote: Live by this credo: have a little laugh at life and look around you for happiness instead of sadness. Laughter has always brought me out of unhappy situations.
author: Red Skelton

quote: You take away all the other luxuries in life, and if you can make someone smile and laugh, you have given the most special gift: happiness.
author: Brad Garrett

quote: The sound of laughter is like the vaulted dome of a temple of happiness.
author: Milan Kundera

quote: Here is my prescription to heal all wounds. author: Beth Ditto

quote: Vegas means comedy, tragedy, happiness and sadness all at the same time.
author: Artie Lange

quote: The secular world looks to the church and to its chagrin, finds no love, no life, no laughter, no hope and no happiness.
author: Rod Parsley

quote: Look up, laugh loud, talk big, keep the color in your cheek and the fire in your eye, adorn your person, maintain your health, your beauty and your animal spirits.
author: William Hazlitt

quote: Good humor is the health of the soul, sadness is its poison.
author: Lord Chesterfield

quote: Cynicism is humor in ill health.
author: H. G. Wells

quote: It's funny, I do try to maintain health. I started doing Bikram yoga which is that hothouse yoga, the 105 degrees yoga for 90 minutes. It's great, you purge out all the sweat and you're drinking water.
author: Bryan Cranston

quote: Today's business and health care climate may not be pleasant. Cutbacks, pay cuts and layoffs do not make anyone's job easy. But that does not mean that the humor need stop.
author: Allen Klein

quote: The Chinese government wants me to say that for many centuries Tibet has been part of China. Even if I make that statement, many people would just laugh. And my statement will not change past history. History is history.
author: Dalai Lama

quote: I believe that imagination is stronger than knowledge. That myth is more potent than history. That dreams are more powerful than facts. That hope always triumphs over experience. That laughter is the only cure for grief. And I believe that love is stronger than death.
author: Robert Fulghum

quote: We are living in the machine age. For the first time in history the comedian has been compelled to supply himself with jokes and comedy material to compete with the machine. Whether he knows it or not, the comedian is on a treadmill to oblivion.
author: Fred Allen

quote: I want to write a book which is the history of comedy.
author: John Cleese

quote: We can't understand when we're pregnant, or when our siblings are expecting, how profound it is to have a shared history with a younger generation: blood, genes, humor. It means we were actually here, on Earth, for a time - like the Egyptians with their pyramids, only with children.
author: Anne Lamott

quote: In almost every interview someone asks what does HIM stand for. I can't even remember our latest lie about that. When Hanson was hot, we said it means Hanson Is Murder. author: Ville Valo

quote: It's a required part of your film history to know who Woody is. His movies are so wonderful, and not just funny but so insightful about human behavior.

quote: The history of the relationship between comedy and swimming is short indeed. Of course it is always funny when someone falls into water, but that's about it.
author: Arthur Smith

quote: As much as I would love to be a person that goes to parties and has a couple of drinks and has a nice time, that doesn't work for me. I'd just rather sit at home and read, or go out to dinner with someone, or talk to someone I love, or talk to somebody that makes me laugh.
author: Daniel Radcliffe

quote: The appreciative smile, the chuckle, the soundless mirth, so important to the success of comedy, cannot be understood unless one sits among the audience and feels the warmth created by the quality of laughter that the audience takes home with it.
