quote: They say Yogi Berra is funny. Well, he has a lovely wife and family, a beautiful home, money in the bank, and he plays golf with millionaires. What's funny about that?
author: Casey Stengel

quote: At home in L.A., Sunday is lazy. It's the wife and me lying in bed with coffee, watching 'The Soup' or something funny on TiVo. The kid will occasionally join us. Eventually, breakfast is at a place down the street called Paty's. And we always have some kind of great dinner - my wife makes a great roast beef.
author: Eric McCormack

quote: I was lucky. My family is wonderful. And it's funny, because most of my best friends come from very large families. So it always felt as if I had lots of siblings, though in the end I had to leave them and go home. I kind of got the best of both worlds as a kid.
author: Sophia Bush

quote: I'm lucky that my real-life Mom has both a great sense of humor about herself and an amazing ability to slip into complete denial if the subject matter gets a little too close to home.
author: Cathy Guisewite

quote: Drama can feel like therapy whereas comedy feels like there's been a pressure and a weight lifted off of you. You come to work and you laugh all day, you go home and you feel light and there's a certain feeling when you're sitting with the audience and they leave after 90 minutes and it's just pure escapism and they're happy.
author: Gabrielle Union

quote: You come to work and you laugh all day, you go home and you feel light and there's a certain feeling when you're sitting with the audience and they leave after 90 minutes and it's just pure escapism and they're happy.
author: Gabrielle Union

quote: When I was a kid I didn't feel like I fit in because - this is really silly and I probably shouldn't say it, but, I didn't think anything was funny. So I used to go home and literally cry to my mom and my step-dad at the time and I didn't think anything was funny. I couldn't laugh.
author: Courteney Cox

quote: My great hope is to laugh as much as I cry to get my work done and try to love somebody and have the courage to accept the love in return.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: I believe that imagination is stronger than knowledge. That myth is more potent than history. That dreams are more powerful than facts. That hope always triumphs over experience. That laughter is the only cure for grief. And I believe that love is stronger than death.
author: Robert Fulghum

quote: When people talk of the freedom of writing, speaking or thinking I cannot choose but laugh. No such thing ever existed. No such thing now exists but I hope it will exist. But it must be hundreds of years after you and I shall write and speak no more.
author: John Adams

quote: Comedy is defiance. It's a snort of contempt in the face of fear and anxiety. And it's the laughter that allows hope to creep back on the inhale.
author: Will Durst

quote: I know some people say I can be funny. But there is always a deeper meaning to what I say. I am a socialist at heart and have the interests of the poor in mind. When people see how I manage to work my way out of tough situations, it gives them hope in their own life.
author: Lalu Prasad Yadav

quote: I hope you will go out and let stories happen to you, and that you will work them, water them with your blood and tears and you laughter till they bloom, till you yourself burst into bloom.
author: Clarissa Pinkola Estes

quote: I enjoy comedy and I hope that people enjoy watching me do it.
author: David Duchovny

quote: I hope in my lifetime we can all continue to laugh at ourselves and not put down anyone for what they weigh.
author: Richard Simmons

quote: I don't know now if I'm funny. I just keep talking and hope that I hit something that's funny.
author: Craig Ferguson

quote: You probably found 'How to Survive a Robot Uprising' in the humor section. Let's just hope that is where it belongs.
author: Daniel H. Wilson

quote: You learn timing on the road. You learn structure and how to read an audience. You learn so much about the business of laughter that you can't learn on a set, because it's all on you. Sometimes you bomb, and you know not to tell that joke again... You just hope people find the humor in the awkwardness.
author: Marlon Wayans

quote: The way you deal with a scare is the way you deal with a laugh. The timing has to be perfect. When you're dealing with fear or laughter - emotions that happen spontaneously - you hope it's working. But in the moment, you really have no idea.
author: Patrick Wilson

quote: A joke is a very serious thing.
author: Winston Churchill

quote: Humor is mankind's greatest blessing.
author: Mark Twain

quote: Common sense and a sense of humor are the same thing, moving at different speeds. A sense of humor is just common sense, dancing.
author: William James

quote: If I had no sense of humor, I would long ago have committed suicide.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: A person without a sense of humor is like a wagon without springs. It's jolted by every pebble on the road.
author: Henry Ward Beecher

quote: A sense of humor... is needed armor. Joy in one's heart and some laughter on one's lips is a sign that the person down deep has a pretty good grasp of life.
author: Hugh Sidey

quote: You can turn painful situations around through laughter. If you can find humor in anything, even poverty, you can survive it.
author: Bill Cosby

quote: Imagination was given to man to compensate him for what he is not a sense of humor to console him for what he is.
author: Francis Bacon

quote: Everywhere is within walking distance if you have the time.
author: Steven Wright

quote: Start every day off with a smile and get it over with.
author: W. C. Fields

quote: The secret to humor is surprise.
author: Aristotle

quote: When humor goes, there goes civilization.
author: Erma Bombeck

quote: Alimony is like buying hay for a dead horse.
author: Groucho Marx

quote: A well-developed sense of humor is the pole that adds balance to your steps as you walk the tightrope of life.
author: William Arthur Ward

quote: My computer beat me at checkers, but I sure beat it at kickboxing.
author: Emo Philips

quote: A sense of humor is a major defense against minor troubles.
author: Mignon McLaughlin

quote: Humor is reason gone mad.
author: Groucho Marx

quote: Like a welcome summer rain, humor may suddenly cleanse and cool the earth, the air and you.
author: Langston Hughes

quote: Humor is perhaps a sense of intellectual perspective: an awareness that some things are really important, others not and that the two kinds are most oddly jumbled in everyday affairs.
author: Christopher Morley

quote: Comedy is simply a funny way of being serious.
author: Peter Ustinov

quote: A taste for irony has kept more hearts from breaking than a sense of humor, for it takes irony to appreciate the joke which is on oneself.
author: Jessamyn West

quote: Humor is laughing at what you haven't got when you ought to have it.
author: Langston Hughes

quote: Humor is emotional chaos remembered in tranquility.
author: James Thurber

quote: Wit - the salt with which the American humorist spoils his intellectual cookery by leaving it out.
author: Ambrose Bierce

quote: Analyzing humor is like dissecting a frog. Few people are interested and the frog dies of it.
author: E. B. White

quote: Humor brings insight and tolerance. Irony brings a deeper and less friendly understanding.
author: Agnes Repplier

quote: Humor is just another defense against the universe.
author: Mel Brooks

quote: Wit is the lowest form of humor.
author: Alexander Pope

quote: Humor is richly rewarding to the person who employs it. It has some value in gaining and holding attention, but it has no persuasive value at all.
author: John Kenneth Galbraith

quote: Humor is one of the best ingredients of survival.
author: Aung San Suu Kyi

quote: A humorist is a person who feels bad, but who feels good about it.
author: Don Herold

quote: A sense of humor is the ability to understand a joke - and that the joke is oneself.
author: Clifton Paul Fadiman

quote: A pun is the lowest form of humor, unless you thought of it yourself.
author: Doug Larson

quote: Humor is something that thrives between man's aspirations and his limitations. There is more logic in humor than in anything else. Because, you see, humor is truth.
author: Victor Borge

quote: If you could choose one characteristic that would get you through life, choose a sense of humor.
author: Jennifer Jones

quote: A laugh is a surprise. And all humor is physical. I was always athletic, so that came naturally to me.
author: Chevy Chase

quote: Humour is the weapon of unarmed people: it helps people who are oppressed to smile at the situation that pains them.
author: Simon Wiesenthal

quote: Humor is a serious thing. I like to think of it as one of our greatest earliest natural resources, which must be preserved at all cost.
author: James Thurber

quote: In conversation, humor is worth more than wit and easiness more than knowledge.
author: George Herbert

quote: Humor is everywhere, in that there's irony in just about anything a human does.
author: Bill Nye

quote: Gags die, humor doesn't.
author: Jack Benny

quote: All I know about humor is that I don't know anything about it.
author: Fred Allen

quote: Humor can alter any situation and help us cope at the very instant we are laughing.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Humor is the affectionate communication of insight.
author: Leo Rosten

quote: You can't study comedy it's within you. It's a personality. My humor is an attitude.
author: Don Rickles

quote: Comedy has to be based on truth. You take the truth and you put a little curlicue at the end.
author: Sid Caesar

quote: Humor does not diminish the pain - it makes the space around it get bigger.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Humor is the instinct for taking pain playfully.
author: Max Eastman

quote: Get well cards have become so humorous that if you don't get sick you're missing half the fun.
author: Flip Wilson

quote: What a strange world this would be if we all had the same sense of humor.
author: Bernard Williams

quote: Comedy, we may say, is society protecting itself - with a smile.
author: J. B. Priestley

quote: The satirist shoots to kill while the humorist brings his prey back alive and eventually releases him again for another chance.
author: Peter De Vries

quote: I have a fine sense of the ridiculous, but no sense of humor.
author: Edward Albee

quote: There seems to be no lengths to which humorless people will not go to analyze humor. It seems to worry them.
author: Robert Benchley

quote: Humor is by far the most significant activity of the human brain.
author: Edward de Bono

quote: The more I live, the more I think that humor is the saving sense.
author: Jacob August Riis

quote: One doesn't have a sense of humor. It has you.
author: Larry Gelbart

quote: When a thought takes one's breath away, a grammar lesson seems an impertinence.
author: Thomas W. Higginson

quote: I think the next best thing to solving a problem is finding some humor in it.
author: Frank A. Clark

quote: Puns are a form of humor with words.
author: Guillermo Cabrera Infante

quote: This I conceive to be the chemical function of humor: to change the character of our thought.
author: Lin Yutang

quote: Nothing is so galling to a people not broken in from the birth as a paternal, or in other words a meddling government, a government which tells them what to read and say and eat and drink and wear.
author: Thomas W. Higginson

quote: There is no defense against adverse fortune which is so effectual as an habitual sense of humor.
author: Thomas W. Higginson

quote: Great men are rarely isolated mountain peaks they are the summits of ranges.
author: Thomas W. Higginson

quote: Humor is merely tragedy standing on its head with its pants torn.
author: Irvin S. Cobb

quote: Through humor, you can soften some of the worst blows that life delivers. And once you find laughter, no matter how painful your situation might be, you can survive it.
author: Bill Cosby

quote: Humor is the first of the gifts to perish in a foreign tongue.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: Humor must not professedly teach and it must not professedly preach, but it must do both if it would live forever.
author: Mark Twain

quote: A woman has to be intelligent, have charm, a sense of humor, and be kind. It's the same qualities I require from a man.
author: Catherine Deneuve

quote: In truth, politeness is artificial good humor, it covers the natural want of it, and ends by rendering habitual a substitute nearly equivalent to the real virtue.
author: Thomas Jefferson

quote: There is a thin line that separates laughter and pain, comedy and tragedy, humor and hurt.
author: Erma Bombeck

quote: Anybody with a sense of humor is going to put on my album and laugh from beginning to end.
author: Eminem

quote: Don't wish me happiness - I don't expect to be happy it's gotten beyond that, somehow. Wish me courage and strength and a sense of humor - I will need them all.
author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

quote: I think I have always had a little humor.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: Good humor is a tonic for mind and body. It is the best antidote for anxiety and depression. It is a business asset. It attracts and keeps friends. It lightens human burdens. It is the direct route to serenity and contentment.
author: Grenville Kleiser

quote: Humor is the most engaging cowardice.
author: Robert Frost

quote: I met Woz when I was 13, at a friend's garage. He was about 18. He was, like, the first person I met who knew more electronics than I did at that point. We became good friends, because we shared an interest in computer and we had a sense of humor. We pulled all kinds of pranks together.
author: Steve Jobs

quote: Dad needs to show an incredible amount of respect and humor and friendship toward his mate so the kids understand their parents are sexy, they're fun, they do things together, they're best friends. Kids learn by example. If I respect Mom, they're going to respect Mom.
author: Tim Allen

quote: Humor has been the balm of my life, but it's been reserved for those close to me, not part of the public Lana.
author: Lana Turner

quote: I think people are sexy when they have a sense of humor, when they are smart, when they have some sense of style, when they are kind, when they express their own opinions, when they are creative, when they have character.
author: Suzanne Vega

quote: There are men so philosophical that they can see humor in their own toothaches. But there has never lived a man so philosophical that he could see the toothache in his own humor.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: Being a Hot Mom means being respected as a mom and a woman. And, the key to being a Hot Mom is having a sense of humor about yourself and all the crazy situations that arise.
author: Jami Gertz

quote: The overwhelming majority of Americans are possessed of two great qualities a sense of humor and a sense of proportion.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

quote: True humor springs not more from the head than from the heart. It is not contempt its essence is love. It issues not in laughter, but in still smiles, which lie far deeper.
author: Thomas Carlyle

quote: The problem with having a sense of humor is often that people you use it on aren't in a very good mood.
author: Lou Holtz

quote: Humor has justly been regarded as the finest perfection of poetic genius.
author: Thomas Carlyle

quote: Imagination was given to man to compensate him for what he isn't. A sense of humor was provided to console him for what he is.
author: Horace Walpole

quote: One of the things that binds us as a family is a shared sense of humor.
author: Ralph Fiennes

quote: Good humor is the health of the soul, sadness is its poison.
author: Lord Chesterfield

quote: A sense of humor keen enough to show a man his own absurdities will keep him from the commission of all sins, or nearly all, save those worth committing.
author: Samuel Butler

quote: Women, as they grow older, rely more and more on cosmetics. Men, as they grow older, rely more and more on a sense of humor.
author: George Jean Nathan

quote: Humor has bailed me out of more tight situations than I can think of. If you go with your instincts and keep your humor, creativity follows. With luck, success comes, too.
author: Jimmy Buffett

quote: I think the scariest person in the world is the person with no sense of humor.
author: Michael J. Fox

quote: Any man who has had the job I've had and didn't have a sense of humor wouldn't still be here.
author: Harry S. Truman

quote: Honest good humor is the oil and wine of a merry meeting, and there is no jovial companionship equal to that where the jokes are rather small and laughter abundant.
author: Washington Irving

quote: Good humor is one of the best articles of dress one can wear in society.
author: William Makepeace Thackeray

quote: Humor does not rescue us from unhappiness, but enables us to move back from it a little.
author: Mason Cooley

quote: Having a sense of humor has served me more than it has hurt me - just in the sense that it has allowed me to keep my sanity.
author: Dee Dee Myers

quote: Your attitude is like a box of crayons that color your world. Constantly color your picture gray, and your picture will always be bleak. Try adding some bright colors to the picture by including humor, and your picture begins to lighten up.
author: Allen Klein

quote: You are not angry with people when you laugh at them. Humor teaches tolerance.
author: W. Somerset Maugham

quote: A lot of my humor does come from anger. It's like, you're not gonna pull one over on me - which is pretty much my motto anyways.
author: Courteney Cox

quote: A sense of humor is great - it goes a long, long way in a marriage.
author: Chris Rock

quote: I don't think it's possible to have a sense of tragedy without having a sense of humor.
author: Christopher Hitchens

quote: I realize that humor isn't for everyone. It's only for people who want to have fun, enjoy life, and feel alive.
author: Anne Wilson Schaef

quote: Men are happy to be laughed at for their humor, but not for their folly.
author: Jonathan Swift

quote: I am often the brunt of my own humor.
author: Charles R. Swindoll

quote: Cynicism is humor in ill health.
author: H. G. Wells

quote: In prehistoric times, mankind often had only two choices in crisis situations: fight or flee. In modern times, humor offers us a third alternative fight, flee - or laugh.
author: Robert Orben

quote: And I loved Fats Waller. I love his instrumental abilities, his vocal abilities and his sense of humor.
author: Paul McCartney

quote: I like a man who can be a real friend, has a good sense of humor, a good pair of shoes and a healthy gold card.
author: Victoria Beckham

quote: OK, in all seriousness, I would say I couldn't be in a relationship without equality, generosity, integrity, spirit, kindness and humor. And awesomeness.
author: Jennifer Aniston

quote: Total absence of humor renders life impossible.
author: Sidonie Gabrielle Colette

quote: Confidence is at the root of so many attractive qualities, a sense of humor, a sense of style, a willingness to be who you are no matter what anyone else might think or say and it's true, I do have a certain fondness for women that have dark hair.
author: Wentworth Miller

quote: Sometimes the only way to deal with horrific things in life is through a dark sense of humor.
author: Margaret Cho

quote: Our subconscious minds have no sense of humor, play no jokes and cannot tell the difference between reality and an imagined thought or image. What we continually think about eventually will manifest in our lives.
author: Robert Collier

quote: Whatever else an American believes or disbelieves about himself, he is absolutely sure he has a sense of humor.
author: E. B. White

quote: If you can get humor and seriousness at the same time, you've created a special little thing, and that's what I'm looking for, because if you get pompous, you lose everything.
author: Paul Simon

quote: A sense of humor is good for you. Have you ever heard of a laughing hyena with heart burn?
author: Bob Hope

quote: Absurdity is what I like most in life, and there's humor in struggling in ignorance. If you saw a man repeatedly running into a wall until he was a bloody pulp, after a while it would make you laugh because it becomes absurd.
author: David Lynch

quote: There are different kinds of humor, some is sarcastic, some introspective. Introspective fit my personality better.
author: Rita Rudner

quote: In my opinion, I think sarcasm and humor in a song, without turning it into a novelty song, is really charming.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: Down the road, I'll probably have a kid or two or three. And there will probably be political events or spiritual things to comment on, and humor.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: It doesn't take many people to have a bad sense of humor to get in trouble at a corporation.
author: Scott Adams

quote: I remember when humor was gentle pokes. I used to call it 'arm around the shoulder' humor. Now they go for the jugular and they take no prisoners. It's mean, mean stuff.
author: Robert Orben

quote: Humor starts like a wildfire, but then continues on, smoldering, smoldering for years.
author: Robert Orben

quote: Keep your sense of humor, my friend if you don't have a sense of humor it just isn't funny anymore.
author: Wavy Gravy

quote: Humor comes from self-confidence.
author: Rita Mae Brown

quote: Humor is always based on a modicum of truth. Have you ever heard a joke about a father-in-law?
author: Dick Clark

quote: Smiling is definitely one of the best beauty remedies. If you have a good sense of humor and a good approach to life, that's beautiful.
author: Rashida Jones

quote: I think people appreciate a songwriter who shows different sides. The whole angst thing is cool, but if that's all you've got, it's just boring. Everything I write, whether it's happy or sad, has a sense of humor to it.
author: Katy Perry

quote: Wit is a weapon. Jokes are a masculine way of inflicting superiority. But humor is the pursuit of a gentle grin, usually in solitude.
author: Frank Muir

quote: The first ingredient in conversation is truth, the next good sense, the third good humor, and the fourth wit.
author: William Temple

quote: And I would be the first to admit that probably, in a lot of press conferences over the time that I have been in coaching, indulging my own sense of humor at press conferences has not been greatly to my benefit.
author: Bobby Knight

quote: An emotional man may possess no humor, but a humorous man usually has deep pockets of emotion, sometimes tucked away or forgotten.
author: Constance Rourke

quote: No mind is thoroughly well organized that is deficient in a sense of humor.
author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

quote: In some sort of crude sense, which no vulgarity, no humor, no overstatement can quite extinguish, the physicists have known sin and this is a knowledge which they cannot lose.
author: J. Robert Oppenheimer

quote: You have to have a sense of humor about life to get through it.
author: Kesha

quote: Humor is an affirmation of dignity, a declaration of man's superiority to all that befalls him.
author: Romain Gary

quote: Using no control and using humor will build a relationship and make a dent to where the client puts the counselor in their quality world and then begins to relate and seek out the counselor. Effective therapy begins with the acceptance of the therapist into the client's quality world.
author: William Glasser

quote: Humor is not a mood but a way of looking at the world. So if it is correct to say that humor was stamped out in Nazi Germany, that does not mean that people were not in good spirits, or anything of that sort, but something much deeper and more important.
author: Ludwig Wittgenstein

quote: It's continuously humbling to work hard, you know? As long as you've got a good work ethic and a sense of humor, I don't think anybody can become too much of an egoist under those circumstances.
author: Rachael Ray

quote: Bad humor is an evasion of reality good humor is an acceptance of it.
author: Malcolm Muggeridge

quote: I always thought the biggest failing of Americans was their lack of irony. They are very serious there! Naturally, there are exceptions... the Jewish, Italian, and Irish humor of the East Coast.
author: Colin Firth

quote: Have a sense of humor about life - you will need it. And be courteous.
author: Peter Jennings

quote: If I didn't try to eavesdrop on every bus ride I take or look for the humor when I go for a walk, I would just be depressed all the time.
author: Lynda Barry

quote: The nation that complacently and fearfully allows its artists and writers to become suspected rather than respected is no longer regarded as a nation possessed with humor or depth.
author: James Thurber

quote: I've got a great sense of humor.
author: Anthony Hopkins

quote: We can't understand when we're pregnant, or when our siblings are expecting, how profound it is to have a shared history with a younger generation: blood, genes, humor. It means we were actually here, on Earth, for a time - like the Egyptians with their pyramids, only with children.
author: Anne Lamott

quote: People of humor are always in some degree people of genius.
author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

quote: It's easier to sit there and say you don't like feminists because they don't have a sense of humor.
author: Joan Jett

quote: I've met a lot of people who've lost their jobs and they still have a sense of humor.
author: Louis C. K.

quote: I don't understand how somebody wouldn't have a sense of humor about themselves.
author: John Malkovich

quote: There is also this benefit in brag, that the speaker is unconsciously expressing his own ideal. Humor him by all means, draw it all out, and hold him to it.
author: Miguel de Cervantes

quote: A little perspective, like a little humor, goes a long way.
author: Allen Klein

quote: There are certain things I learned when I first started learning about acting, to try and place the character physically and emotionally. And the way you place them emotionally is often with humor.
author: David Duchovny

quote: A lot of people into Tool, for some reason, are not interested in humor.
author: Maynard James Keenan

quote: I'm just very amused by five-year-old humor.
author: Kesha

quote: If the blood humor is too strong and robust, calm it with balance and harmony.
author: Xun Zi

quote: What we're doing is fun - if you have any sense of humor at all!
author: Calvin Klein

quote: As far as humor goes, I've always been a very insecure person and I've always wanted to be liked.
author: Peter Steele

quote: It's good to be able to laugh at yourself and the problems you face in life. Sense of humor can save you.
author: Margaret Cho

quote: Married people should not be quick to hear what is said by either when in ill humor.
author: Samuel Richardson

quote: From sixteen to twenty, all women, kept in humor by their hopes and by their attractions, appear to be good-natured.
author: Samuel Richardson

quote: My father could be very witty, even if the humor was always on the darker side of irony.
author: Maurice Sendak

quote: I suppose I miss the British cynicism and the humor.
author: Rod Stewart

quote: People who know me , they know I have a sense of humor, I'm a bit of a joker, a bit of a clown really, and I would love someone to exploit that side of me and send me a romantic comedy.
author: Gary Oldman

quote: Congratulations, you have a sense of humor. And to those who didn't: Go stick your head in the mud.
author: Jesse Ventura

quote: It's your outlook on life that counts. If you take yourself lightly and don't take yourself too seriously, pretty soon you can find the humor in our everyday lives. And sometimes it can be a lifesaver.
author: Betty White

quote: If this humor be the safety of our race, then it is due largely to the infusion into the American people of the Irish brain.
author: William Howard Taft

quote: You find out in life that people really like you funny. So what do you give 'em? Humor. And then if you show them the other side, they don't like you as much. I find, too, that I can hide behind the idiot's mask being funny, and you never see the sorrow or the pain.
author: Terry Bradshaw

quote: It has always surprised me how little attention philosophers have paid to humor, since it is a more significant process of mind than reason. Reason can only sort out perceptions, but the humor process is involved in changing them.
author: Edward de Bono

quote: Feature-length film comedy is harder to pull off than the episodic sitcom - it doesn't have the same factory machinery up and running, teams of writers putting familiar characters through permutations - but that doesn't explain the widening quality gap that makes movie humor look like a genetic defective.
author: James Wolcott

quote: When you say a friend has a sense of humor do you mean that he makes you laugh, or that he can make you laugh?
author: Max Frisch

quote: Humor is very very risky, particularly for a candidate, unless he's been in so long that it just doesn't matter, and he's not running for president. But it's just that people are so sensitive and so touchy, and you're just going to upset somebody without ever realizing it.
author: Mark Russell

quote: The reason why you know more funny dudes than funny chicks is that dudes are funnier than chicks. If my daughter has a mediocre sense of humor, I'm just gonna tell her, 'Be a staff writer for a sitcom. Because they'll have to hire you, they can't really fire you, and you don't have to produce that much. It'll be awesome.'
author: Adam Carolla

quote: You may not be able to change a situation, but with humor you can change your attitude about it.
author: Allen Klein

quote: My life is part humor, part roses, part thorns.
author: Bret Michaels

quote: Newspaper people, once celebrated as founts of ribald humor and uncouth fun, have of late lost all their gaiety, and small wonder.
author: Russell Baker

quote: I like to deal with EVERY aspect of our condition, and that means terror and humor in equal mix. Some books have more room for humor than others.
author: Dean Koontz

quote: Our records, if you have a dark sense of humor, were funny, but our records weren't about comedy. They were about protests, fantasy, confrontation and all that.
author: Ice Cube

quote: A lot of stars don't have a sense of humor.
author: Kathy Griffin

quote: You've got to have a sense of humor to keep your sanity.
author: Lance Bass

quote: Writing a novel is one of those modern rites of passage, I think, that lead us from an innocent world of contentment, drunkenness, and good humor, to a state of chronic edginess and the perpetual scanning of bank statements.
author: J. G. Ballard

quote: I could not tread these perilous paths in safety, if I did not keep a saving sense of humor.
author: Horatio Nelson

quote: Well, darkness with humor... I'm not an extremely suicidal or sad person.
author: Peter Steele

quote: I have this horrible sense of humor where I think discomfort is funny - partly because I experience discomfort a lot, and it's a way of laughing at it and getting a release.
author: Joaquin Phoenix

quote: Well, I mean, if a joke or humor is bawdy, it's got to be funny enough to warrant it. You can't just have it bawdy or dirty just for the sake of being that - it's got to be funny.
author: Betty White

quote: I like bawdy humor. I love bawdy humor, but not dirty humor.
author: Betty White

quote: It is characteristic of all deep human problems that they are not to be approached without some humor and some bewilderment.
author: Freeman Dyson

quote: I love the diversity of America. I love the plain, normal sense of humor Americans have. It is not wicked, like in some countries. And I also love how new America is.
author: Antonio Banderas

quote: If one tends to be a humorous person and you have a sense of humor the rest of your life then you can certainly lighten the load, I think, by bringing that to your trials and tribulations. It's easy to have a sense of humor when everything is going well.
author: Alan Thicke

quote: Humor is such a wonderful thing, helping you realize what a fool you are but how beautiful that is at the same time.
author: Lynda Barry

quote: Every time I do a movie like 'Finding Neverland' or 'Chocolat' or 'Shakespeare' in Love,' we deal with the creative process, but there's humor and fun along the way. I always love that kind of movie.
author: Harvey Weinstein

quote: There is nothing like the way people feel after they've seen 'The Intouchables.' They feel amazing. The word of mouth on this film is incredible. It's intelligent-feeling good. You're not insulted by the low-browness or stupidity of some of the humor. It's so smart and terrific.
author: Harvey Weinstein

quote: There are just certain things that turn my head. It may be a girl's sense of humor, it may be her wit, or her belief system it could be a lot of different things.
author: Jensen Ackles

quote: I find that people find a way out of misery through humor and it's humor that's often unacceptable to people who are not in quite such a state of misery.
author: Danny Boyle

quote: I'm lucky that my real-life Mom has both a great sense of humor about herself and an amazing ability to slip into complete denial if the subject matter gets a little too close to home.
author: Cathy Guisewite

quote: When humor can be made to alternate with melancholy, one has a success, but when the same things are funny and melancholic at the same time, it's just wonderful.
author: Francois Truffaut

quote: I want someone who can keep me on my toes, has a good sense of humor and a good heart.
author: Carmen Electra

quote: I have a very silly sense of humor. I've never laughed harder in my entire life than seeing someone with toilet paper stuck on the bottom of their shoe.
author: Paula Poundstone

quote: Whether it's viewers of the show or readers of my columns and books, I'm consistently impressed with their wit, humor and insight. That goes for about 95 percent of the audience. The other five percent are why the 'Delete' option and restraining orders were invented.
author: Richard Roeper

quote: Mixing humor and politics is something that works.
author: Bryan Cranston

quote: People with no humor, they're outta my life.
author: Patti LaBelle

quote: My fam is just a regular family. But all of them have great senses of humor.
author: Dane Cook

quote: The rejection that we all take and the sadness and the aggravation and the loss of jobs and all of the things that we live through in our lives, without a sense of humor, I don't know how people make it.
author: Marlo Thomas

quote: I don't have a caustic sense of humor. What I find funny, that humor comes from a much gentler place.
author: Vera Farmiga

quote: I love poking fun at myself. I have a rather mean sense of humor.
author: Alton Brown

quote: I think a lot of humor is about distracting yourself. Pretend you're not trying to make it funny. Because for some reason the effort to be funny smells like sulphur in our culture.
author: Sloane Crosley

quote: It's funny. People often compare me to other humor essayists. They're usually quite nice comparisons I will accept those gladly. But I am always sort of appalled at the idea of being lumped with other, more chick-y female writers. And the truth is probably that neither comparison is accurate.
author: Sloane Crosley

quote: I think that sense of humor is important in marriage. A sense of humor gets people through marriage.
author: Kyle Chandler

quote: Sometimes a scene may be about one thing, and it may end up still being about that, but the emotionality of it comes from somewhere else, or the humor of it comes from somewhere else, and it gives it that real-life quality.
author: Kyle Chandler

quote: The darker the film, the more vital everyone's sense of humor is on set.
author: Eric Bana

quote: You know, I'm Australian, and we have got the worst sense of humor. We are cruel to each other.
author: Steve Irwin

quote: I have wit in my work and a sense of humor, but I do not use irony in any way.
author: John Zorn

quote: I find intelligence sexy. I find a sense of humor sexy. I find sensitivity sexy.
author: Nicole Appleton

quote: If I ever have sex with someone I might be able to develop a sense of humor.
author: Kate Beckinsale

quote: I realized women and humor were linked very closely.
author: Craig Ferguson

quote: Me and Matt love to argue, but in general our sense of humor is pretty much alike.
author: Trey Parker

quote: We are, in the comics, the last frontier of good, wholesome family humor and entertainment.
author: Bil Keane

quote: I just am a snob when it comes to humor.
author: Courteney Cox

quote: One of my favorite things about 'Star Trek' wasn't just the overt banter but the humor in that show about the relationships between the main characters and their reactions to the situations they would face there was a lot of comedy in that show without ever breaking its reality.
author: J. J. Abrams

quote: There are two insults no human being will endure: that he has no sense of humor, and that he has never known trouble.
author: Sinclair Lewis

quote: I wore goofy hats to school and did musical theater. Most people thought I was a dork. But if you have a sense of humor about it, no one can bring you down.
author: Zac Efron

quote: Tony and I had a good on and off screen relationship, we are two very different people, but we did share a sense of humor, we now live in different parts of the world but when we find ourselves in the same place it is more or less as if there had been no years in between.
author: Roger Moore

quote: Cathy was the first widely syndicated humor strip created by a woman. The strip was pretty revolutionary at the time not only because it starred a female, but also because it was so emotionally honest about all the conflicting feelings many women had in 1976.
author: Cathy Guisewite

quote: There's always a source for humor.
author: Calvin Trillin

quote: If you're that hypersensitive about color and don't have a sense of humor, don't marry out of your race.
author: Laura Schlessinger

quote: The humor section is the last place an author wants to be. They put your stuff next to collections of Cathy cartoons.
author: David Sedaris

quote: When I look at a lot of older stuff that I've written, I think one sign of amateur humor writing is when you see people trying too hard.
author: David Sedaris

quote: The comics that are just conversing with you up there and drawing on their own life, yeah, I guess so. I guess some do political humor, some do topical humor, but the ones that I like, the ones that are appealing to me, were guys who were just talking to you about their life.
author: Ray Romano

quote: Both conservatives and liberals watch 'Parks and Recreation,' and they each think the show is for them, which is really cool. 'SNL' was totally different. It was exciting because everyone was paying attention. Political humor works when people know what you're talking about.
author: Amy Poehler

quote: A sense of humor is the ability to understand a joke - and that the joke is oneself.
author: Clifton Fadiman

quote: I believe that economists put decimal points in their forecasts to show they have a sense of humor.
author: William Gilmore Simms

quote: When you do find humor in trying times, one of the first and most important changes you experience is that you see your perplexing problems in a new way - you suddenly have a new perspective on them.
author: Allen Klein

quote: One of my pet peeves is that sometimes the talents of my band get overlooked because, and it was the same problem that Frank Zappa had, with a lot of groups that use humor, people don't realize there's a lot of craft behind the comedy.
author: Al Yankovic

quote: It's hard to force creativity and humor.
author: Al Yankovic

quote: In the 'Hurt Locker' there's a lot of me in there, a sense of humor, a man of few words and a lot of action.
author: Jeremy Renner

quote: My stories are very somber, so I think I need the comic ingredient. Besides, life has so much humor.
author: Manuel Puig

quote: I don't think humor is forced upon my universe it's a part of it.
author: Manuel Puig

quote: The comic is the perception of the opposite humor is the feeling of it.
author: Umberto Eco

quote: I wish I could be as thin as Jessica Simpson. I think she looks gorgeous! I have had Jessica on my show several times, and I can tell you that girl is genuine and funny with a great self-deprecating sense of humor.
author: Rachael Ray

quote: I'm sure there are people who survive tragedy without humor, but I've never met any of them. Nor would I be particularly interested in writing about them if I did meet them.
author: Ayelet Waldman

quote: Men live by intervals of reason under the sovereignty of humor and passion.
author: Thomas Browne

quote: What's great about the geek spirit is that life never seems to stop us, and they never seem to kill our enthusiasm, our optimism and our hunger to experience the world. We keep our sense of humor, we protect our dignity, we talk to our friends about the experience and then we start again fresh the very next day.
author: Paul Feig

quote: Women's humor seems to be a little more supportive. It's just kind of trying to make the other one laugh through funny voices and kind of talking about other people. I respond to that. I feel less like I'm going to get beat up in a room full of women than I do in a room full of guys.
author: Paul Feig

quote: I want everything I do to have humor in it, because it seems to me that all of life has that.
author: Lawrence Kasdan

quote: Things can be funny only when we are in fun. When we're 'dead earnest,' humor is the only thing that is dead.
author: Flip Wilson

quote: I get asked, 'How can you have such failures in your films?' Well, what else is life about? There's some sense of constant failure in something. Humor gives you a distance from it.
author: Alexander Payne

quote: Humor can be an incredible, lacerating and effective weapon.
author: Carl Hiaasen

quote: My books are shelved in different places, depending on the bookstore. Sometimes they can be found in the Mystery section, sometimes in the Humor department, and occasionally even in the Literature aisle, which is somewhat astounding.
author: Carl Hiaasen

quote: Humor can be an incredible lacerating and effective weapon. And that is the way I use it.
author: Carl Hiaasen

quote: The first glass is for myself, the second for my friends, the third for good humor, and the forth for my enemies.
author: William Temple

quote: I don't think my sense of humor has changed at all I was born with this, for better or for worse.
author: Ivan Reitman

quote: I can't not find humor in elements of most parts of life, but at the same time nothing ever seems perpetually funny to me.
author: Greg Kinnear

quote: At the risk of appearing disingenuous, I don't really think of myself as 'writing humor.' I'm simply reporting on the world I observe, which is frequently hilarious.
author: Richard Russo

quote: I never worry about people not taking my work seriously as a result of the humor. In the end, the comic's best trick is the illusion that comedy is effortless. That people imagine what he's doing is easy is an occupational hazard.
author: Richard Russo

quote: Putting a little time aside for clean fun and good humor is very necessary to relieve the tensions of our time.
author: Hattie McDaniel

quote: Those years on the golf course as a caddie, boy, those people were something. They were vulgar, some were alcoholics, racist, they were very difficult people to deal with. A lot of them didn't have a sense of humor.
author: Martin Sheen

quote: You see, that's another thing that my parents gave me: an enormously great sense of humor.
author: Liza Minnelli

quote: People come up to me as I leave the stage after a performance and tell me tey saw my mother onstage with me every time I sing. I keep a sense of humor about it.
author: Lorna Luft

quote: I don't think I would describe my sense of humor. Doesn't sound like the kind of thing I'd do.
author: Tommy Lee Jones

quote: I think in life, the sense of humor and comedy always exists.
author: Mike Epps

quote: Stand-up comics reflect less of a visual humor and more of a commentary.
author: Shel Silverstein

quote: I can't not put humor in a book.
author: Albert Brooks

quote: As I get older, my sense of humor is my biggest asset.
author: David Alan Grier

quote: With Ricky Gervais, it's all shades of wrong, it's my kind of humor.
author: Emily Blunt

quote: I don't know how many sacred cows there are today. I think there's a little confusion between humor and gross passing for humor. That's kind of regrettable.
author: Bob Newhart

quote: I'll do humor about myself, I'll poke fun and everything, but that's me and I can do it to me. I think it's cruel to do it to somebody else.
author: Delta Burke

quote: I don't happen to have a sense of humor personally, so I don't know what's funny about a character... This happens to be a feature of my life generally.
author: Wallace Shawn

quote: With humor, it's so subjective that trying to think of what the ideal reader would think would drive you crazy.
author: Calvin Trillin

quote: People who know me know I have a sense of humor that can really push the envelope.
author: Carmen Electra

quote: Any film which views the darker side of life, which is death with a sense of humor, is very much to my taste.
author: Carter Burwell

quote: I love Sell Out, I think it's great. I love the jingles. The whole thing as an album is a wonderful piece of work. The cover. Everything about it. It's got humor, great songs, irony.
author: Roger Daltrey

quote: If golf wasn't enjoyable and there wasn't a lot of humor and enjoyment, even though the game is so frustrating, you would wonder why you put yourself through it.
author: Ray Romano

quote: Political correctness? In my humor, I never talk about politics. I was never much into all that.
author: Don Rickles

quote: Advertisers also know that humor can help bond us to their product.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Laughter, and the broader category of humor, are key elements in helping us go on with our life after a loss.
author: Allen Klein

quote: When we are dealing with death we are constantly being dragged down by the event: Humor diverts our attention and lifts our sagging spirits.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Whether planned or not, humor takes our mind off of our troubles.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Any attempts at humor immediately after September 11th were deemed tasteless.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Since the goal of my programs is to show audiences how humor can both help them heal as well as deal with not-so-funny stuff, I decided to discuss the events of the previous week, the pain all of us were feeling, and how humor and some laughter might be beneficial.
author: Allen Klein

quote: In looking for humor, keep in mind this guideline: Sometimes it takes a little time to see the humor in your upsets you may not find something to laugh about immediately.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Sometimes it takes ten seconds to see some humor in your dilemmas, sometimes ten years.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Throughout history, great leaders have known the power of humor.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Humor can be one of our best survival tools.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Today's business and health care climate may not be pleasant. Cutbacks, pay cuts and layoffs do not make anyone's job easy. But that does not mean that the humor need stop.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Humor can help you cope with the unbearable so that you can stay on the bright side of things until the bright side actually comes along.
author: Allen Klein

quote: When we can find some humor in our upsets, they no longer seem as large or as important as they once did.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Humor expands our limited picture frame and gets us to see more than just our problem.
author: Allen Klein

quote: Philip Larkin has a tough honesty and sense of humor that I find irresistible, as a contemporary poet.
author: Robert Morgan

quote: Sometimes the only way to make palatable that which is appalling and apprehensive is to season it with some humor.
author: Terrence Howard

quote: My humor tends to be a little more edgy than is appropriate for 'Twilight,' although I got some in there. That was fun! There's just a tonal difference. For me, storytelling is storytelling. But, I do like writing for grown ups.
author: Melissa Rosenberg

quote: Everybody's got a different sense of humor. It's just different styles.
author: Colin Quinn

quote: For the most part, comedians are pretty friendly with each other. They always say they badmouth each other, but most of the time, they're friends. We're the only ones that can really stand our type of humor.
author: Colin Quinn

quote: I used to watch 'The Waltons' and sob because my family was nothing like that. We had a cruel sense of humor in my family.
author: Paula Poundstone

quote: Insult is powerful. Insult begets both rage and humor and often at the same time.
author: Suzanne Fields

quote: I think in my case, I had no choice but to have a good sense of humor. I grew up with my dad, Danny Thomas, and George Burns and Bob Hope and Milton Berle and Sid Caesar and all those guys were at our house all the time and telling jokes and making each other laugh.
author: Marlo Thomas

quote: Bathroom humor, fart, and poo poo humor in movies gets a laugh. It's a pretty easy audience, and that's been around for ages.
author: Selma Blair

quote: The love of truth lies at the root of much humor.
author: Robertson Davies

quote: I really hate sitcoms on television with canned laughter and stuff. What really makes me laugh is the real-life stuff. I've got a dry sense of humor.
author: Katie Price

quote: I've never met a person who has more integrity than my husband. I respect that. There's his humor and intelligence, too, and he's really cute, all those things - but if you don't respect your partner, you'll get sick of him.
author: Michelle Pfeiffer

quote: When you meet someone new who instantly gets you, your sense of humor and your attitudes and your worldview, even if theirs are different - and you get them in return. You both talk and talk and agree and laugh and nod and yes, yes, of course you should get another round of drinks.
author: Erin Morgenstern

quote: I visited Jobs for the last time in his Palo Alto, Calif., home. He had moved to a downstairs bedroom because he was too weak to go up and down stairs. He was curled up in some pain, but his mind was still sharp and his humor vibrant.
author: Walter Isaacson

quote: I think sometimes my humor is extremely dry, and a lot of times I would say things that I thought were very funny but... I have a reputation of - people think of me as a very fundamentalist, humorless fellow.
author: Ian MacKaye

quote: Conservative humor is frankly harder than liberal humor. You get points for just being liberal. You can get more points if you make fun of your own side sometimes.
author: Ted Rall

quote: Even as a kid I was never the generator of humor, but I always knew who was funny, who to hang out with.
author: Andrew Stanton

quote: It felt as if things were literally slipping through my fingers. Things were just streaming away from me. I lost my sense of humor. I'm still looking for that.
author: Michelle Williams

quote: Our ability to find humor in the world, to make connections between previously unconnected notions, to create new ideas, to share in a common culture: All these essentially human acts depend on memory.
author: Joshua Foer

quote: The guys in my band are great-we watch movies, we eat pizza, take walks, read books. Everybody has a really great sense of humor. And my boyfriend comes and visits me on the road.
author: Lisa Loeb

quote: You can find heroism everyday, like guys working terrible jobs because they've got to support their families. Or as far as humor, the things I see on the job, on the street, are far funnier than anything you'll ever see on TV.
author: Harvey Pekar

quote: I consider myself to have a decent sense of humor. What's life without a sense of humor?
author: Mayer Hawthorne

quote: My sense of humor is a turkey, and I pull it out of the oven and baste it in reality.
author: Tracy Morgan

quote: To me, sadness and humor aren't disrelated and humor is the best tool I've had against the sadness in my life.
author: Mike Mills

quote: As a person, he was wonderful. He really was a great person. He was full of life. He had a great sense of humor. Very talented, of course, but very caring to his parents. There was a very endearing quality about Elvis.
author: Priscilla Presley

quote: My type of humor is me not caring whether people know what I'm talking about or not.
author: John Hodgman

quote: It is the ability to take a joke, not make one, that proves you have a sense of humor.
author: Max Eastman

quote: If you get a diagnosis, get on a therapy, keep a good attitude and keep your sense of humor.
author: Teri Garr

quote: The humor is essentially dark for a cartoon and sophisticated. But at the same time, being a cartoon gives the writers more freedom than in a normal sitcom. It always pushes the line that, despite human failings, the Simpsons are really decent people.
author: Dan Castellaneta

quote: I make fun of situations and try and find the humor in things, but it's never at the expense of the other guy.
author: Bob Uecker

quote: To this day, I've found that it doesn't matter what a guy looks like if he's really funny. His sense of humor makes him attractive. On the other hand, you don't hear men saying, 'No she's not pretty, but is she ever funny!'
author: Catherine O'Hara

quote: That is the saving grace of humor, if you fail no one is laughing at you.
author: A. Whitney Brown

quote: I tried to go out for theater or theater arts, but I was too scared or too intimidated. But I had a lot of friends on the cross country team that had great senses of humor.
author: Dana Carvey

quote: There are so many things to talk about between black people, Hispanic people, white people, gay people, men, women, it's all based on fear. We all have fears, this thing that stops us from embracing as we are one. We are never going to be one. People are messed up, but humor lets us see how ignorant we can be.
author: Marlon Wayans

quote: Humor helps ease the tension of race and the differences in society. If there wasn't comedy I don't know if Obama could have ever become president.
author: Marlon Wayans

quote: You learn timing on the road. You learn structure and how to read an audience. You learn so much about the business of laughter that you can't learn on a set, because it's all on you. Sometimes you bomb, and you know not to tell that joke again... You just hope people find the humor in the awkwardness.
author: Marlon Wayans

quote: I try to cope with everything through humor.
author: Gail Porter

quote: I think that different pleasures work for different readers - a friend of mine won't read anything that's not a cardiovascular sort of page-turner. I tend to care less about plot, but I'm a sucker for humor and strangeness.
author: Karen Russell

quote: We do not take humor seriously enough.
author: Konrad Lorenz

quote: Colombian humor is very black, very sarcastic.
author: Barbet Schroeder

quote: Some major writers have a huge impact, like Ayn Rand, who to my mind is a lousy fiction writer because her writing has no compassion and virtually no humor. She has a philosophical and economical message that she is passing off as fiction, but it really isn't fiction at all.
author: Theodore Sturgeon

quote: Even celebrities, most people have a sense of humor. Most of the people we meet who we've done on the show, like it.
author: Matt Stone

quote: Never say a humorous thing to a man who does not possess humor. He will always use it in evidence against you.
author: Herbert Beerbohm Tree

quote: I think hip-hop does a very good job of infusing comedy and humor and wit into music, a lot more than other genres.
author: Carrie Brownstein

quote: With Portlandia, I don't think our intention is always to find something funny. Sometimes the humor comes from taking something really seriously. We're okay with making somebody feel uncomfortable or uneasy.
author: Carrie Brownstein

quote: I try to bring it across on my record, in my dress, in what I do and what I say because to me humor is important. You should have a dose of that and I guess giving it is what I'm here for.
author: Bootsy Collins

quote: Men love it. They have a sense of humor, whereas a lot of women are threatened or just don't get it.
author: Lara Flynn Boyle

quote: I have a dark sense of humor.
author: Olivia Munn

quote: With actors like Steve McQueen, Paul Newman and Harrison Ford, what made them such icons is that even in dramatic movies, their characters had a sense of humor.
author: Patrick Wilson

quote: I love a man with a great sense of humor and who is intelligent - a man who has a great smile. He has to make me laugh. I like a man who is very ambitious and driven and who has a good heart and makes me feel safe. I like a man who is very strong and independent and confident - that is very sexy - but at the same time, he's very kind to people.
author: Nicole Scherzinger

quote: They don't make you pay for the humor. It's up and down, but they're trying to give you as many laughs as possible in 2 minutes. They are the most honest comedians ever.
author: Mike Judge

quote: I don't know if my sense of humor goes over Americans' heads.
author: Ryan Kwanten

quote: I think the Canadian sense of humor is dryer than America's and juicier than Britain's. I think it's a cross between the two of them, really.
author: Scott Thompson

quote: I think Canadian humor is a little less broad than American humor.
author: Scott Thompson

quote: Anyone in the humor business isn't thinking clearly if he doesn't surround himself with idea people. Otherwise, you settle for mediocrity - or you burn yourself out.
author: Hank Ketcham

quote: Bob Hope, like Mark Twain, had a sense of humor that was uniquely American, and like Twain, we'll likely not see another like him.
author: Dick Van Dyke

quote: You probably found 'How to Survive a Robot Uprising' in the humor section. Let's just hope that is where it belongs.
author: Daniel H. Wilson

quote: Well, it's a humor strip, so my first responsibility has always been to entertain the reader... But if, in addition, I can help move readers to thought and judgment about issues that concern me, so much the better.
author: Garry Trudeau

quote: Humor can inform and break down stigma, which is a huge issue in the military.
author: Garry Trudeau

quote: My dad's sense of humor was direct and sometimes surreal - his quick wit is well known amongst our family and friends. He raised me on Spike Jones records and W.C. Fields movies, and his sense of humor fell somewhere in between.
author: Tony Visconti

quote: But it also became the experience, or was the experience, of the writers who were attracted to this kind of humor. They're all men or women who come from the same kind of experience in their own lives.
author: Norman Lear

quote: If you look at the game and everything, it's not quite like looking at an animated film, because that's total character. This, this is really movement, but it's got funny little things if you look for the humor. They're actually getting to the character.
author: Don Bluth

quote: Sometimes Americans don't quite get my sense of humor. My good ol' British sarcasm seems to go over their heads.
author: Lee Westwood

quote: I'm not an expert on the Malaysian sense of humor.
author: Ben Stiller

quote: The polls indicated that I was feisty, that I was tough, that I had a sense of humor, but they weren't quite sure if they liked me and they didn't know whether or not that I was sensitive.
author: Geraldine Ferraro

quote: He was just trying to tease me - I knew that later - but he said he'd have to leave because it wasn't fair to have anyone in the room who was going to make fun of what he had to say. He had a good sense of humor, really.
author: Fay Wray

quote: I appreciate humor so much, but I'm actually not a funny girl.
author: Emmanuelle Chriqui

quote: I suppose I look for humor in most situations because it humanizes things it makes a character much more three-dimensional if there's some kind of humor. Not necessarily laugh-out-loud type of stuff, just a sense that there is a humorous edge to things. I do like that.
author: Colm Meaney

quote: Some people say my humor focuses too much on stereotypes. It doesn't. It focuses on facts.
author: Sarah Silverman

quote: I'm not for gratuitous nudity, but if there's humor, I don't have a problem.
author: Rebecca Romijn

quote: There's a hysterical, tired sense of humor that comes after working 14 hours a day, six days a week. I like those things because they take the pressure off the constant stress.
author: Tom Berenger

quote: Negative humor is forgotten immediately. It's the stuff that makes us feel better about our lives that lives long. Much more satisfying. Enter children's books.
author: Berkeley Breathed

quote: My legacy would be that you don't have to give up anything. You can be chic but have a sense of humor, you can be sexy but comfortable, you can be timeless but fresh.
author: Michael Kors

quote: I mean, yeah, I'm sure that Python and the other things have paved the way for a greater understanding of the British sense of humor, but I don't think it's all that different than the American sense of humor.
author: Simon Pegg

quote: I think at its best the American sense of humor is the same as the British sense of humor at its best, which is to be wry and ironic and self deprecating.
author: Simon Pegg

quote: However, frat-boy humor is funny and it always will be.
author: Craig Kilborn

quote: My dad instilled in me a great sense of humor. I wasn't bullied at school because my outward attitude was confident, and that helps.
author: Warwick Davis

quote: My parents armed me with an amazing sense of humor, and it's what you need when, well, it's what anyone needs in this world.
author: Warwick Davis

quote: We are really living the American dream, to be a successful brand in the States and in Europe and to steep ourselves in our heritage. But we do it with a sense of humor. We don't take ourselves too seriously in fashion.
author: Tommy Hilfiger

quote: I'll let you in on a secret: I can't stand Jay Ward. I hate being compared to Rocky and Bullwinkle. It's just a different style of humor.
author: John Kricfalusi

quote: Joe Barbera's s always complaining that he can't get humor into cartoons anymore. Just do it. You've got your money. Why do they let the networks run their lives?
author: John Kricfalusi

quote: A farce, or slapstick humor, does well universally.
author: John Ratzenberger

quote: Sure, the comedians who swear or use scatological humor can get laughs, but they're uncomfortable laughs.
author: John Ratzenberger

quote: I think up until the point when we started in the business, which was in the early '70s, most of the humor was political. The smart humor was political satire.
author: David Zucker

quote: Do feminists have a sense of humor? Yes.
author: Gloria Allred

quote: I genuinely liked all of the cast members very much. Steve had a wicked sense of humor. I remember Russell coming to my rescue, once. I watched Eric evolve before everyone's eyes. Maurice loved what he did, so. He treated his character with respect, down to the costuming.
author: Madeleine Stowe

quote: Lesbian humor isn't trying to sell anything, it doesn't have to sell out. Coming out as a lesbian onstage is still a very political act if it weren't, more women would do it.
author: Kate Clinton

quote: Confidence and a good sense of humor can usually win a chick over.
